name: scRNAseq_Benchmark
description: We present a comprehensive evaluation of automatic cell identification methods for single-cell RNA sequencing data. All the code used for the evaluation is available on GitHub ( https://github.com/tabdelaal/scRNAseq_Benchmark ). Additionally, we provide a Snakemake workflow to facilitate the benchmarking and to support the extension of new methods and new datasets.
evaluation_method: F1 (and clustering metrics such as ARI / NMI where applicable)
notes: Benchmark evaluates automated cell-type identification across diverse scRNA-seq datasets; affected by batch effects, annotation heterogeneity, and dataset-specific preprocessing. Provides reproducible Snakemake workflow; not an LLM benchmark.
